title: TADM selective sparse memory under a fixed memory budget
null_hypothesis: H0: weighted sparse retention has retrieval accuracy <= budget-matched uniform retention.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: weighted sparse retention has retrieval accuracy > budget-matched uniform retention.

title: EMG multi-hop temporal/causal reasoning
null_hypothesis: H0: EMG multi-hop query accuracy <= flat episodic lookup accuracy.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: EMG multi-hop query accuracy > flat episodic lookup accuracy.

title: Dream consolidation for redundancy/conflict compression
null_hypothesis: H0: consolidation does not reduce retained record count relative to no consolidation.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: consolidation retains fewer records than no consolidation.

title: PAD-modulated risk-sensitive action selection
null_hypothesis: H0: PAD-aware policy has unsafe-action rate >= affect-agnostic policy.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: PAD-aware policy has unsafe-action rate < affect-agnostic policy.

title: Temporal Action Modulation: remember/postpone/forget
null_hypothesis: H0: TAM total deadline-weighted utility <= FIFO/immediate baseline utility.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: TAM total deadline-weighted utility > FIFO/immediate baseline utility.

title: Automatic cue determination
null_hypothesis: H0: auto-cue success <= random/fixed cue success.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: auto-cue success > random/fixed cue success.

title: Curiosity-driven novelty/uncertainty exploration
null_hypothesis: H0: curiosity-guided agent discovers <= useful latent opportunities than no-curiosity exploration.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: curiosity-guided agent discovers > useful latent opportunities than no-curiosity exploration.

title: Intuition heuristic prior for familiar decisions
null_hypothesis: H0: intuition provides no reduction in decision cost relative to full deliberation.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: intuition reduces decision cost relative to full deliberation.

title: Knowledge bootstrapping / memory transplant
null_hypothesis: H0: compatible memory transplant target accuracy <= scratch target accuracy at the same low-data budget.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: compatible memory transplant target accuracy > scratch target accuracy at the same low-data budget.

title: SharedGLTM societal/global memory transfer
null_hypothesis: H0: reliability-weighted SharedGLTM novice accuracy <= local-only novice accuracy.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: reliability-weighted SharedGLTM novice accuracy > local-only novice accuracy.

title: Validator consensus plus reflective safety layer
null_hypothesis: H0: consensus+reflection unsafe execution rate >= single-validator unsafe execution rate.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: consensus+reflection unsafe execution rate < single-validator unsafe execution rate.

title: Incremental confidence/credibility conflict resolution
null_hypothesis: H0: credibility-weighted final fact accuracy <= unweighted frequency/recency baseline.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: credibility-weighted final fact accuracy > unweighted frequency/recency baseline.

title: Validated counterfactual dream rehearsal
null_hypothesis: H0: validated dream rehearsal held-out composition accuracy <= replay-only accuracy.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: validated dream rehearsal held-out composition accuracy > replay-only accuracy.

title: Input quality gating and cross-validation (GIGO mitigation)
null_hypothesis: H0: gated final belief accuracy <= accept-all baseline accuracy under corrupted inputs.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: gated final belief accuracy > accept-all baseline accuracy under corrupted inputs.

title: Trust-weighted observational imitation with safety validation
null_hypothesis: H0: safe trust-weighted imitation few-shot task reward <= no-imitation learner reward.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: safe trust-weighted imitation few-shot task reward > no-imitation learner reward.

title: Memory precedence from repetition, emotion, centrality, and cue match
null_hypothesis: H0: precedence-ranked first-recall utility <= recency-only first-recall utility in the aligned regime.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: precedence-ranked first-recall utility > recency-only first-recall utility in the aligned regime.

title: Social-state projection (empathy proxy)
null_hypothesis: H0: social-state projection coordination reward <= self-only coordination reward.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: social-state projection coordination reward > self-only coordination reward.

title: Counterfactual dream/validation mitigation of induced cognitive bias
null_hypothesis: H0: mitigation bias error >= unmitigated biased-memory error.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: mitigation bias error < unmitigated biased-memory error.

title: Persistent character priors
null_hypothesis: H0: character-conditioned within-profile behavioral consistency <= no-character baseline consistency.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: character-conditioned within-profile behavioral consistency > no-character baseline consistency.

title: Purpose-conditioned planning versus myopic action selection
null_hypothesis: H0: purpose-guided goal-completion utility <= myopic immediate-reward utility.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: purpose-guided goal-completion utility > myopic immediate-reward utility.

title: Multi-agent negotiation and arbitration
null_hypothesis: H0: negotiated joint utility <= first-proposal/single-controller joint utility.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: negotiated joint utility > first-proposal/single-controller joint utility.

title: Time-critical survival override
null_hypothesis: H0: survival-override success <= normal consensus success on time-critical threats.
alternative_hypothesis: HA: survival-override success > normal consensus success on time-critical threats.
